record.paper_title: Open Problems in Constructive Function Theory
record.original_question: If the Boltzmann-Shannon entropy E_n of an orthonormal polynomial sequence has the same asymptotic extremal behavior as in the Chebyshev case, does that asymptotic property characterize the Chebyshev family among all orthogonal polynomial systems, for example throughout the whole Szegő class?

evidence.quote: QUESTION 5.1. Does the property E_n ... characterize the family of Chebyshev polynomials? ... but what about, say the whole Szegő class?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mu$ be a finite positive Borel measure on $[-1,1]$ with infinite support, and let $(p_n)_{n\ge 0}$ be the associated sequence of orthonormal polynomials, i.e., $p_n$ has degree $n$, positive leading coefficient, and $\int_{-1}^{1} p_n(x) p_m(x)\, d\mu(x) = \delta_{nm}$. The Boltzmann–Shannon entropy of $p_n$ with respect to $\mu$ is defined by
$$E_n(\mu) \;=\; -\int_{-1}^{1} p_n(x)^2 \, \log\bigl(p_n(x)^2\bigr) \, d\mu(x).$$
For the (first-kind) Chebyshev measure $d\mu_T(x) = \pi^{-1}(1-x^2)^{-1/2}\,dx$ the orthonormal polynomials satisfy a known extremal asymptotic behavior of $E_n$ as $n\to\infty$ (namely $E_n(\mu_T)$ attains, in the limit, the extremal value characteristic of the Chebyshev case).

Recall that $\mu$ belongs to the Szegő class on $[-1,1]$ if $\mu$ is absolutely continuous with weight $w(x) = d\mu/dx$ satisfying
$$\int_{-1}^{1} \frac{\log w(x)}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}\, dx \;>\; -\infty.$$

Question: Suppose $\mu$ lies in the Szegő class and the sequence $E_n(\mu)$ exhibits the same asymptotic extremal behavior as $E_n(\mu_T)$ for the Chebyshev measure. Does this asymptotic property force $\mu$ to be the Chebyshev measure (up to the standard normalization), i.e., does the asymptotic extremality of the Boltzmann–Shannon entropy characterize the Chebyshev family within the entire Szegő class?
artifact.status_search_result: A web search returned related work on discrete and asymptotic entropies of orthogonal polynomials and on the Szegő class, but no source was found that explicitly settles whether asymptotic extremality of the Boltzmann–Shannon entropy characterizes the Chebyshev measure throughout the Szegő class. The question appears to remain open, but the search was inconclusive.

status_evidence.title: Discrete entropies of orthogonal polynomials
status_evidence.snippet: Computes Shannon-type entropies for Chebyshev polynomials; notes Chebyshev first-kind have entropies independent of n.
status_evidence.claim: Related work studies entropies of Chebyshev polynomials but does not establish a characterization in the Szegő class.

status_evidence.title: Zero sets, entropy, and pointwise asymptotics of orthogonal polynomials
status_evidence.snippet: Proves a version of Szegő's formula and pointwise convergence results for orthonormal polynomials on the unit circle.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work addresses entropy-type asymptotics for orthogonal polynomials but does not explicitly resolve the Chebyshev characterization question.

status_evidence.title: Entropy function and orthogonal polynomials
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates entropy functions associated to orthogonal polynomial systems.
status_evidence.claim: No explicit confirmation that asymptotic entropy extremality characterizes Chebyshev within the full Szegő class.
